'''Lev Kepzen''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Feral (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Feral'']]<ref name="Orbit" /> sometime around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], after leading an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] taskforce&mdash;including the ''Feral''&mdash;on a three-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] hunt for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band known as the [[Solar Terrors]], Kepzen managed to [[Capture of the Solar Terrors|capture]] the pirates at their [[Solar Terrors's base|base]]. [[Venslas Beeli]], the leader of the pirates, surrendered when he realized that he was outnumbered.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lev Kepzen was mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. ''The Far Orbit Project'' was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
